Following the successful initial readout, we announced another milestone with the initiation of Part 2 of the maintenance study.

Top-line data from the company’s prior Phase 2 VENTURE study of VK2735 in adults with obesity demonstrated statistically significant reductions in mean body weight from baseline, ranging up to 14.7% after 13 weekly doses, with no signs of plateau.
Top-line results demonstrated statistically significant reductions in mean body weight after 13 weeks, ranging up to 12.2% from baseline.
